intelligent-console.title: Intelligent Copy Test
intelligent-console.heading: Intelligent Copy Test
intelligent-console.intro: Save the shared provider and model, run non-destructive copy tests, and inspect seven days of records.

provider.label: Chat provider
provider.help: A blank provider follows the triggering group-message session and cannot be tested from this page.

model.label: Model ID
model.placeholder: Blank uses the provider default model
model.help: Choose a candidate or enter a custom model ID that was not enumerated.
model.unavailable: Model candidates are unavailable; a custom model ID can still be entered.

repeat.title: Intelligent repeat copy test
repeat.description: Generates one test copy with the saved interrupt prompt. No group message is sent.

mute.title: Intelligent mute notice test
mute.description: Generates copy for “Test user / 60 seconds”. It never mutes, sends a message, or changes group state.

history.title: Intelligent copy records
history.empty: There are no records in this time range.
history.privacy: Records never retain group text, generated copy, sender identifiers, exception details, or credentials. Data older than seven days is cleaned in the background.

common.configuration_not_loaded: Load the saved configuration before saving changes.
common.unknown_error: The operation failed. Please try again later.
